dispute_evidence_uploads_committed_camer.name: dispute_evidence_uploads_committed_camera_sha256_unique
dispute_evidence_uploads_committed_camer.where: "dispute_evidence_uploads"."status" = 'COMMITTED' AND "dispute_evidence_uploads"."camera_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "dispute_evidence_uploads"."content_sha256" IS NOT NULL

payment_operation_idem_in_progress_inten.name: payment_operation_idem_in_progress_intent_unique
payment_operation_idem_in_progress_inten.where: payment_intent_id is not null and response_status = 409 and response_body->>'error' = 'PAYMENT_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS'

ws_auth_tickets_scope_ck.name: ws_auth_tickets_scope_ck
ws_auth_tickets_scope_ck.value:
(
      ("websocket_auth_tickets"."channel" = 'notification' AND "websocket_auth_tickets"."resource_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("websocket_auth_tickets"."channel" = 'negotiation' AND "websocket_auth_tickets"."resource_id" IS NOT NULL)
    )
